summary: One command builds a managing or managed tenant, and every Entra admin gets a Temporary Access Pass.

new.title: One command builds an MSP pair
new.text: A single command builds a managing tenant or a managed tenant step by step. It shows the plan first and ends by listing the steps that need a person.
new.action: Build the managing tenant first, then each managed tenant.

fixes.title: Every Entra admin gets a Temporary Access Pass
fixes.text: The create TAP setting can no longer turn the pass off in any setup. Validation flags a "no" and offers a one-click fix.

fixes.title: The Manager gets only read permissions
fixes.text: A deployment now gives the Manager only its read-only set of permissions.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The full deployment now uses your database admin group name and troubleshooting identity, and can create and fill that group itself.
